scope: Pure deployment change (GPU swap A40 -> RTX 4090), zero code changes, zero quality risk -- same bit-exact-proven forward/decode paths used throughout this session.

training.note: RTX 4090 is cheaper in total dollars AND faster in wall-clock despite 68% higher hourly rate

inference_decode.metric: tokens/second, BDH streaming decode, context=65536, manual CUDA graph (zero launch overhead, proven mechanically identical on both GPUs)
inference_decode.explanation: Decode was independently proven memory-bandwidth-bound this session (manual CUDA graph eliminated launch overhead with no effect). RTX 4090's ~1008GB/s memory bandwidth vs A40's ~696GB/s (~1.45x) predicts roughly this speedup; measured speedup slightly exceeds the naive bandwidth-ratio prediction.

conclusion: A pure deployment change (deploy on RTX 4090 instead of A40) delivers a real, measured throughput improvement on both training (~1.5-1.9x, also cheaper) and inference decode (~1.65x), with zero architecture changes, zero code changes beyond --gpu-id, and zero quality/correctness risk since it reuses already bit-exact-proven code paths.
